greeting: Spy Master Veil on comms. Stage 2: Shadows in the Palace. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Fallen Crown. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I catalog omens by flavor now. Today tastes like burnt citrus and bad decisions.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Infiltrate the Ministry of Unity.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Infiltrate the Ministry of Unity; Steal the Grand Unification plans; Escape undetected. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Gather intelligence on the Void's final plan. Immediate move: Infiltrate the Ministry of Unity.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 2 resolved: Shadows in the Palace. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Usurper's Throne.
rumor: Patrol routes keep changing to avoid one unlit corridor no one claims to have seen.
People keep repeating one clue from Shadows in the Palace: 'Escape undetected'.
A pigeon outranked three commanders here last week. Merit system is broken.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn gives the cleanest sightlines in the capital ruins. Move before crowds regroup.
dialog.time_noon: Noon is surveillance peak. Assume every lane is observed.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk favors ambush teams and rumor storms. Confirm every briefing twice.
dialog.time_night: Night in the crown district means quiet knives and loud mistakes. Stay disciplined.

party_reactions.kade: Spy Master Veil sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Spy Master Veil accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Spy Master Veil talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: No speeches. Give me actionable details.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You made it back. Report status.
relationship_dialog.friend: With you here, the odds stop looking stupid.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Same plan as always: adapt, push, survive, repeat.
